tasks.label: check: dashboard api status
tasks.command: node -e "(async()=>{ try { const res=await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3002/api/status'); const body=await res.json(); console.log('status code', res.status); console.log('open count', body.portfolio?.openPositionCount); if(Array.isArray(body.portfolio?.positions)){ body.portfolio.positions.slice(0,20).forEach(p=>console.log(`${p.symbol} ${p.chain} ${p.address}`)); } else { console.log('positions not array', body.portfolio?.positions); } } catch(e){ console.error('error', e && e.message ? e.message : e); process.exit(1);} })();"
